jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description:
Rieter is the world’s leading system supplier for processing natural and man-made fibers into short-staple and long-staple yarn, as well as for the production of filament yarns, man-made fibers and nonwovens. With its comprehensive technology portfolio, Rieter covers the entire textile value chain – from fiber to yarn, and from polymer melt to texturized filament, synthetic staple fibers and nonwoven. Headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland, the company designs and engineers complex spinning plants, machines, systems, and components that enable an efficient and economical production. Rieter’s leading technologies ensure minimal resource consumption, making a significant contribution to sustainability across the global textile value chain. Rieter has a history spanning more than 230 years, operates 22 production sites in nine countries, and employs around 6 400 people worldwide, approximately 9% of them in Switzerland. Rieter is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange under the ticker symbol RIEN.

re you a service-oriented network professional who enjoys working in a global environment? Are you curious, solution-focused and motivated to continuously improve secure and reliable network services? Then you could be a great addition to our team as a

General	As Senior Network Engineer, you play a key role in providing secure, stable and scalable network services that support Rieter’s global business needs. Together with the team, you are responsible for the design, implementation, operation and support of internally managed network services. You collaborate closely with colleagues across Rieter as well as with external partners.

Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities

• Design, build and operate the global network infrastructure, central network services and network security solutions

• Develop, operate and monitor the global data center network infrastructure

• Provide second- and third-level support for network infrastructure and services

• Analyze internal customer requirements and develop secure, scalable network solutions

• Ensure compliance with global architecture, configuration and security standards

• Continuously improve the design, performance and reliability of existing network environments

• Lead and contribute to network projects, including infrastructure and service lifecycle activities, cloud connectivity and network security

• Support and guide apprentices in the networking area

Your Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or HF in Computer Engineering, Information Technology or related Engineering field or a technical training program

• Seven or more years of professional IT experience

• Extensive knowledge and experience with IT Network technologies

• Demonstrated experience in managing Huawei and Cisco LAN and WLAN components

• In-depth knowledge of ISP and data centre environments (routing, switching, MPLS, BGP, load balancers)

• Very good knowledge of the Windows operating system, security and networking (DNS, DHCP, IP)

• Solid knowledge of IT security, with a focus on firewalls and VPNs

• Many years of experience in network monitoring and troubleshooting

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

• Very good oral and written English skills

• Strong communication skills in an international environment

Our Offer

• The opportunity to play an active role in shaping a high-level IT environment in terms of security technologies

• an international working environment with long tradition

• versatile activity in a future-oriented environment with a lot of self-responsibility

• good development opportunities and fair employment conditions

• a motivated team with mutual respect and good cooperation

Does this appeal to you? If you recognize yourself in this profile and would like to join a successful team, we look forward to getting to know you soon. Please send us your complete application documents online.
Only direct applications will be considered for the advertised position.

• Kundenorientiertes Verhalten

• Faire Anstellungsbedingungen und ein angenehmes Arbeitsklima

jobs.description:
Rieter is the world’s leading system supplier for processing natural and man-made fibers into short-staple and long-staple yarn, as well as for the production of filament yarns, man-made fibers and nonwovens. With its comprehensive technology portfolio, Rieter covers the entire textile value chain – from fiber to yarn, and from polymer melt to texturized filament, synthetic staple fibers and nonwoven. Headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland, the company designs and engineers complex spinning plants, machines, systems, and components that enable an efficient and economical production. Rieter’s leading technologies ensure minimal resource consumption, making a significant contribution to sustainability across the global textile value chain. Rieter has a history spanning more than 230 years, operates 22 production sites in nine countries, and employs around 6 400 people worldwide, approximately 9% of them in Switzerland. Rieter is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange under the ticker symbol RIEN.

As Head of Trade Compliance, you will have overall responsibility for the Trade Compliance Management System (TCMS) of the Rieter Group. You will play a key role in further development, implementation, enforcement, and monitoring of policies, processes, and control mechanisms relating to trade compliance, export controls, and sanctions compliance. In this capacity, you will ensure that all Rieter Group companies comply with applicable national and international trade, export control, and sanctions regulations. Through a risk-based and pragmatic approach, you will foster a sustainable culture of compliance and support management and business functions in addressing regulatory requirements and geopolitical challenges. In the future, and subject to your interest, there may also be an opportunity to assume additional responsibilities in other compliance areas alongside your role as Head of Trade Compliance.

Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities

• Lead and further develop the Group-wide Trade Compliance Management System (TCMS): Assume responsibility for defining, implementing, monitoring, and continuously im-proving the group-wide Trade Compliance governance framework, including policies, procedures, controls, and reporting structures.

• Lead the Trade Compliance organization: Manage and further develop the global Trade Compliance organization and oversee the integration of the MMF Division Trade Compliance organization into the Rieter Group Trade Compliance structure. Provide functional leadership and support to the international Trade Compliance network.

• Ensure export control and sanctions compliance: Ensure compliance with applicable national and international export control, foreign trade, and sanctions regulations, particularly those of Switzerland, the European Union, and the United States, including export classification, license management, embargo screening, and sanctions screening activities.

• Risk management and compliance due diligence: Develop, implement, and enhance risk-based review and monitoring processes for business transactions, business partners, markets, and projects. Identify, assess, and mitigate Trade Compliance risks.

• Advise management and business functions: Serve as a trusted advisor to executive management, senior leadership, and business and support functions on all matters relating to trade compliance, export controls, sanctions compliance, and relevant regulatory and geopolitical developments.

• Training and compliance culture: Develop and deliver training programs and promote a sustainable culture of compliance throughout the Rieter Group.

• Collaboration with authorities and external stakeholders: Establish and maintain relationships with relevant government authorities, customs and export control agencies, logistics providers, industry associations, and external legal counsel.

• Monitor regulatory developments: Continuously monitor and analyze global developments in export controls, sanctions, and international trade law, and develop and implement appropriate measures for the Rieter Group.

Your Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Business Administration, International Trade, Logistics, or a related field. Equivalent qualifications combined with relevant professional experience will also be considered.

• Several years of professional experience in Trade Compliance, export controls, international trade law, or a comparable compliance function, preferably within an international industrial or manufacturing company.

• In-depth knowledge of national and international export control, trade, and sanctions regulations, particularly those of Switzerland, the European Union, and the United States (e.g., EAR, ITAR, OFAC).

• Proven experience in developing, implementing, and enhancing Trade Compliance Management Systems, as well as designing effective compliance processes and internal control frameworks.

• Strong advisory skills, with the ability to serve as a trusted business partner to management and functional stakeholders on strategic and operational matters.

• Proactive, self-driven, and business-oriented mindset with a hands-on approach.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English; additional language skills are considered an asset.

• Experience with ERP systems, particularly SAP, and preferably with Trade Compliance and export control solutions such as SAP GTS, AEB, or comparable systems.

• Knowledge of customs regulations, preferential trade agreements, rules of origin, and supply chain compliance is advantageous.

Our Offer

• A highly visible global role with strategic impact.

• An international working environment with long tradition

• Flexible hybrid working model.

• A motivated team with mutual respect and good cooperation.

• Attractive development opportunities within a leading industrial company.

• The opportunity to broaden your scope over time and, subject to your interests and qualifica-tions, take on additional responsibilities in other compliance areas.

Con il suo portafoglio tecnologico completo, Rieter copre l'intera catena del valore tessile – dalla fibra al filato, e dal polimero sciolto al filamento testurizzato, fibre sintetiche e non tessuto. Con sede a Winterthur, in Svizzera, la società progetta e progetta impianti di filatura complessi, macchine, sistemi e componenti che consentono una produzione efficiente ed economica. Le principali tecnologie di Rieter garantiscono un consumo minimo di risorse, dando un contributo significativo alla sostenibilità in tutta la catena globale del valore tessile. Rieter ha una storia che dura oltre 230 anni, opera 22 siti produttivi in nove paesi, e impiega circa 6 400 persone in tutto il mondo, circa il 9% di loro in Svizzera. Rieter è quotata sulla SIX Swiss Exchange sotto il simbolo RIEN.

In qualità di Capo della Compliance del Commercio, avrete la responsabilità generale per il Sistema di Gestione delle Compliance di Commercio (TCMS) del Gruppo Rieter. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nell'ulteriore sviluppo, implementazione, applicazione e monitoraggio di politiche, processi e meccanismi di controllo relativi alla conformità commerciale, controlli all'esportazione e sanzioni conformità. In questa capacità, si assicurerà che tutte le società del Gruppo Rieter siano conformi alle normative nazionali e internazionali applicabili, di controllo delle esportazioni e di sanzioni. Attraverso un approccio basato sul rischio e pragmatico, si favorirà una cultura sostenibile della conformità e delle funzioni di gestione del supporto e di business nell'affrontare i requisiti normativi e le sfide geopolitiche. In futuro, e in base al vostro interesse, ci può anche essere l'opportunità di assumere ulteriori responsabilità in altri settori di conformità accanto al vostro ruolo di Capo della Compliance commerciale.

Le vostre attività e responsabilità principali

• Guidare e sviluppare ulteriormente il sistema di gestione della conformità commerciale a livello di Gruppo (TCMS): Assumere la responsabilità di definire, implementare, monitorare e continuamente im-proving il quadro di governance di Compliance di gruppo, tra cui politiche, procedure, controlli e strutture di reporting.

• Guidare l'organizzazione Trade Compliance: gestire e sviluppare ulteriormente l'organizzazione globale Trade Compliance e supervisionare l'integrazione dell'organizzazione MMF Division Trade Compliance nella struttura Rieter Group Trade Compliance. Fornire leadership funzionale e supporto alla rete internazionale Trade Compliance.

• Assicurare il controllo delle esportazioni e sanzioni conformità: Assicurare il rispetto del controllo delle esportazioni nazionali e internazionali applicabile, il commercio estero e le norme di sanzioni, in particolare quelle della Svizzera, dell'Unione Europea e degli Stati Uniti, tra cui la classificazione delle esportazioni, la gestione delle licenze, lo screening dell'embargo e le attività di screening delle sanzioni.

• Gestione del rischio e conformità due diligence: sviluppare, implementare e migliorare i processi di revisione e monitoraggio basati sui rischi per le transazioni commerciali, partner commerciali, mercati e progetti. Identificare, valutare e mitigare i rischi di conformità commerciale.

• Consigli per la gestione e le funzioni aziendali: Servire come consulente di fiducia per la gestione esecutiva, la leadership senior e le funzioni di business e supporto su tutte le questioni relative alla conformità commerciale, ai controlli delle esportazioni, alla conformità delle sanzioni e ai relativi sviluppi normativi e geopolitici.

• Cultura della formazione e della conformità: sviluppare e fornire programmi di formazione e promuovere una cultura sostenibile della conformità in tutto il Gruppo Rieter.

• Collaborazione con le autorità e le parti interessate esterne: stabilire e mantenere relazioni con le autorità governative competenti, le agenzie doganali e di controllo delle esportazioni, i fornitori di logistica, le associazioni del settore e il consulente legale esterno.

• Monitorare gli sviluppi normativi: monitorare e analizzare costantemente gli sviluppi globali nei controlli delle esportazioni, nelle sanzioni e nel diritto commerciale internazionale, e sviluppare e attuare misure appropriate per il Gruppo Rieter.

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale in Compliance commerciale, controlli all'esportazione, diritto commerciale internazionale, o una funzione di conformità comparabile, preferibilmente all'interno di una società industriale o manifatturiera internazionale.

• Conoscenza approfondita delle normative nazionali e internazionali in materia di controllo delle esportazioni, commercio e sanzioni, in particolare della Svizzera, dell'Unione europea e degli Stati Uniti (ad esempio, EAR, ITAR, OFAC).

jobs.description:
Rieter is the world’s leading system supplier for processing natural and man-made fibers into short-staple and long-staple yarn, as well as for the production of filament yarns, man-made fibers and nonwovens. With its comprehensive technology portfolio, Rieter covers the entire textile value chain – from fiber to yarn, and from polymer melt to texturized filament, synthetic staple fibers and nonwoven. Headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland, the company designs and engineers complex spinning plants, machines, systems, and components that enable an efficient and economical production. Rieter’s leading technologies ensure minimal resource consumption, making a significant contribution to sustainability across the global textile value chain. Rieter has a history spanning more than 230 years, operates 17 production sites in nine countries, and employs around 4 220 people worldwide, approximately 15.4% of them in Switzerland. Rieter is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange under the ticker symbol RIEN.

You have power, are versatile, service- and goal-oriented? You like to work in a team, are curious and always find innovative ways to reach your goals? Then you fit perfectly within our team and can strengthen our business as

Your Tasks

• Take an active role in technical sales, supporting the global sales organization in value‑based selling, solution definition, and technical‑commercial clarification in complex customer-specific automation and system projects

• Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for automation systems towards the fully automated spinning mill

• Identify market trends and customer requirements and translate them into competitive automation solutions

• Conduct and maintain market and competitor analyses to support portfolio and investment decisions

• Act as Product Owner (PLM) for automation products, engineered solutions, spare parts, and repair offerings across the full lifecycle

• Ensure close collaboration with R&D, engineering, operations, sales, and service to deliver customer‑focused solutions

Your Qualifications

• Minimum 5 years of experience in B2B technical sales, product management, or solution engineering for automation systems (e.g. AGVs, cobots, palletizing solutions)

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Automation, Electrical or Mechatronics Engineering

• Experience in the textile industry is an advantage

• Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills with the ability to align cross-functional teams

• Willingness for global travel

• Openess to other cultures

• Fluent in English and German

Our Offer

• an international working environment with long tradition

• versatile activity in a future-oriented environment with a lot of self-responsibility

• good development opportunities and fair employment conditions

• a motivated team with mutual respect and good cooperation

Are you interested? If you recognize yourself in this profile and you would like to be part of a successful team, we look forward to meeting you soon. Please send us your complete application documents online.

Rieter est le principal fournisseur mondial de systèmes pour la transformation des fibres naturelles et artificielles en fils à agrafes courtes et longues, ainsi que pour la production de fils de filaments, de fibres synthétiques ou artificielles et de nontissés. Avec son portefeuille technologique complet, Rieter couvre l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur textile – de la fibre au fil, de la fonte des polymères au filament texturé, aux fibres synthétiques discontinues et au non-tissés. Basée à Winterthur, en Suisse, l'entreprise conçoit et conçoit des installations de filature complexes, des machines, des systèmes et des composants qui permettent une production efficace et économique. Les technologies de pointe de Rieter assurent une consommation minimale de ressources, ce qui contribue grandement à la durabilité de la chaîne de valeur mondiale du textile. Rieter a une histoire de plus de 230 ans, exploite 17 sites de production dans neuf pays et emploie environ 4 220 personnes dans le monde, dont environ 15,4% en Suisse. Rieter est coté sur la SIX Swiss Exchange sous le symbole RIEN.

• Définir et piloter la vision du produit, la stratégie et la feuille de route pour les systèmes d'automatisation vers la filature entièrement automatisée

• Identifier les tendances du marché et les besoins des clients et les traduire en solutions d'automatisation compétitives

• Mener et maintenir des analyses du marché et des concurrents pour appuyer les décisions de portefeuille et d'investissement

• Agir en tant que propriétaire de produits (PLM) pour les produits d'automatisation, les solutions conçues, les pièces de rechange et les offres de réparation tout au long du cycle de vie

• Assurer une collaboration étroite avec la R-D, l'ingénierie, les opérations, les ventes et le service pour fournir des solutions axées sur la clientèle

Vos qualifications

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en ventes techniques B2B, en gestion de produits ou en ingénierie de solutions pour systèmes d'automatisation (par exemple AGV, cobots, solutions de palettisation)
